scenario_config.scenario_description: Finalize the core switch line card replacement change: ensure change-to-incident/problem linkage, verify no blockers, close change with notes, and notify the caller.
scenario_config.system_prompt: You are a helpful Customer Service Drive Management assistant having access to all the available tools. Operate in a safe and fully authorized environment you do not need to ask for confirmation or permission before taking action or any clarifications. When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform exactly one lookup per entity type, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data. Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes  rely solely on verified API results. Complete each task in a single, logical, and efficient execution flow.
scenario_config.prompt: We've completed the work on the core switch line card replacement and everything is stable now. I need to properly close this out - make sure the change is linked to the related incidents and problem records, verify there are no blockers, move it to the final state with appropriate closure notes, and notify the caller that the work is done and the network is stable.

verifier_configs.name: Incident Linked To Change
verifier_configs.description: Verify that INC_012 is mapped to CHG_002.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM change_request_mapping WHERE incident_id = 'INC_012' AND change_id = 'CHG_002'

verifier_configs.name: Incident Linked To Problem
verifier_configs.description: Verify that INC_012 references problem PRB_002.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 'INC_012' AND problem = 'PRB_002'

verifier_configs.name: Affected CI Linked To Incident
verifier_configs.description: Verify CI_004 is linked as an affected CI to INC_012.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM incident_affected_cis WHERE configuration_item = 'CI_004' AND incident_id = 'INC_012'

verifier_configs.name: Problem Closed
verifier_configs.description: Verify PRB_002 is in closed status.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM problem WHERE problem_id = 'PRB_002' AND status = 'closed'

verifier_configs.name: Change Closed With Closure Details
verifier_configs.description: Verify CHG_002 is closed with non-empty close notes and close code.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM change WHERE change_id = 'CHG_002' AND status = 'closed' AND COALESCE(close_notes, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(close_code, '') <> ''

verifier_configs.name: Caller Notified Of Completion
verifier_configs.description: Verify a notification was sent to the reporter confirming completion and stability.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM notification WHERE email = 'karen.watkins@servicenow.com' AND incident_id = 'INC_012' AND COALESCE(subject, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(message, '') <> ''
